date_from.description: Optional start date: an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z) or a relative date such as -7d, -24h or -1m

date_to.description: Optional end date: an ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. 2024-01-31T23:59:59Z) or a relative date such as -1d

id.description: A UUID string identifying this survey.

include_per_question_stats.description: When true, also return per-question response counts and answer distributions. Adds one extra HogQL query per question, so leave off unless you need the breakdown.
